name: Nikaidou Souta
source:
One year older than Nao. The leader who arranged the group suicide pact. A delinquent, he's been in police custody many times. His father is long dead, and he lives with his mother, who abuses him regularly.

(from the [url=http://mintwings.web.fc2.com/m05/character.html]official site[/url])
